why: The office's function that types a line into the person's terminal for somebody else, and the door a secretary types one line through, refuse in these words (wave 13s round 83). Each needs a terminal holder running, or a secretary under the person's grant or carrying the owner's words for one line, and this test's office holds neither. So a test route throws each. tests/a-line-is-typed-for-somebody-else.test.ts meets the first two through the function itself. tests/a-secretary-types-a-line-in-a-terminal.test.ts meets every one but the terminal that ended in the holder's pause through the door, against a real holder and an older one; that one cannot be timed there.

refusals.english: Test: the terminal holder is older than this office.
Test: the person has a line half typed.
Test: a secretary types one whole line as line.
Test: the owner's words do not name this line in this terminal.
Test: the person typed in the pause, so Enter was not sent.
Test: the terminal ended in the pause, so Enter was not sent.
Test: the person pressed Enter on the line in the pause, so the office did not press Enter.
